message.content: Hey, I’m panicking a bit. It’s 11 PM on a Monday and I just realized I haven’t even started my tax filing. The deadline is 2026-03-23. That’s today.

content.text: Take a deep breath, Thandiwe. Since the deadline is 2026-03-23, you are technically still within the window, but you need to submit before the system closes tonight or early tomorrow morning depending on the specific cutoff time for SARS eFiling. Do you have your IRP5s and IT3(a) certificates ready to upload?

message.content: I have the PDFs from the studio accounts, but I’m not sure about the private food shoots. I did about eight of them last month. Can you pull up my expense tracker so I can check the totals?

content.text: I’m accessing your financial records now. I see eight entries under 'Food Photography - Private Clients' from last month. The total income is R42,500. For expenses, you have listed gear maintenance at R3,200 and travel. Do you want to include the fuel costs for the Llandudny runs or keep those separate as personal?

message.content: Leave the Llandudny runs as personal. I don’t want to complicate it with a mix of hobby and work mileage when I’m already stressed. Just stick to the business expenses. What’s the net taxable income looking like?

content.text: After deducting the R3,200 in gear maintenance and the standard business mileage for the client locations, your net taxable income is approximately R39,100. Given your tax bracket, this will likely result in a small refund or a minimal balance due, depending on your provisional tax payments. Do you want me to draft the submission for you to review?

message.content: Yes, please draft it. But first, can you send a quick reminder to Sipho to handle the dog walk tomorrow morning? Bongo is getting old and I need to be at my computer all night if this goes wrong.

content.text: I’ve sent the notification to Sipho’s phone: 'Please take Bongo for his morning walk tomorrow. Thandiwe is working late on tax filing.' Now, here is the draft of your tax submission. Please confirm the figures match your records before I lock it in for submission.

message.content: Looks correct. Go ahead and submit it. I’m going to make tea and hope the system doesn’t crash. Thanks for saving my life.

content.text: Submission successful. You have received confirmation number FTR-2026-8892. You’re all set for the 2026-03-23 deadline. Now, please go drink your tea and rest. You can handle the rest tomorrow.
